### Why DO NOT SHIP
Defects #1 and #2 are concrete, reproducible correctness bugs in core checkout and registration flows — not cosmetic issues. #1 in particular is a pricing bug, which is the class of defect that should never ship. I'd fix the discount formula and the Tier-submission wiring, then re-test Checkout and Form before reconsidering release.'
